scripts.build: npm run db:check && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run api:openapi:check && npm run docs:generate-api && npm run build --workspace @kac/docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:docs
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run api:openapi:check
scripts.db:setup-local: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.docs:generate-api: npm run api:openapi:export && npm run generate-api --workspace @kac/docs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate-api && npm run dev --workspace @kac/docs
scripts.docs:dev:en: npm run docs:generate-api && npm run dev:en --workspace @kac/docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run api:openapi:check && npm run generate-api --workspace @kac/docs && npm run build --workspace @kac/docs
scripts.docs:check: npm run api:openapi:check && npm run docs:build
scripts.dev:services: concurrently --kill-others -n API,WEB,WORKER,DOCS -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run api:dev" "npm run web:dev" "npm run worker:dev" "npm run serve --workspace @kac/docs"
